titulo.alumno:
«Условия трудового договора»
Reading the terms of an employment contract

intro: In a contract, check the start date, working hours, duration, pay, duties and the procedure for changing conditions.

piezas.titulo: In a contract, check the start date, working hours, duration, pay, duties and the procedure for changing conditions.
texto: In a contract, check the start date, working hours, duration, pay, duties and the procedure for changing conditions.
Do not infer rights or deadlines that the document does not mention; identify mandatory and optional expressions.

frases.estudio: Сотрудник принимается на работу с первого сентября на полный рабочий день.
frases.alumno: The employee starts on 1 September on a full-time basis.

frases.estudio: Испытательный срок и обязанности указаны в отдельных пунктах договора.
frases.alumno: The probation period and the duties appear in separate clauses of the contract.

opciones.explicacion: The first sentence gives the start date.
